architecture-map.summary: Next.js App Router app with three route groups — (marketing) public pages, (focused) anonymous assess wizard + results, (app) auth-gated shell (dashboard/profile/matches/plan/documents/checklist/guide) — plus 17 API routes under app/api and OAuth callback/signout under app/auth. Session refresh runs in root proxy.ts (Next 16 "proxy", not middleware.ts) delegating to lib/supabase/middleware.ts updateSession (@supabase/ssr cookie flow; sets x-pathname header); app/(app)/layout.tsx enforces sign-in via supabase.auth.getUser() + redirect to /auth?next=. lib/ holds 25 modules: versioned rule-based scoring engine, checklist generator/readiness/plan-links, plan generator, outcomes state-machine/funnel/predict, guide (DeepSeek), timing, theme (corridor), and a large sourced-data layer (lib/data/source + per-file Zod schemas with machine-checkable provenance). 15 SQL migrations; all 12 created tables enable (mostly force) RLS. Zod safeParse guards 10 API routes. All four claimed invariants VERIFIED, one nuance: lib/scoring has no server-only import guard (import-graph convention only).
key_facts: ROUTE GROUP (marketing) — public chrome, layout probes auth only to personalise AppBar and degrades to signed-out chrome on probe failure (app/(marketing)/layout.tsx:6-11). Pages: / landing (app/(marketing)/page.tsx), /how, /trust, /destinations, /destinations/[id], /auth (sign-in page); own error.tsx + loading.tsx.

ROUTE GROUP (focused) — distraction-free chrome (FocusBar only, no auth gate; app/(focused)/layout.tsx). Pages: /assess = anonymous 9-step wizard (app/(focused)/assess/page.tsx), /assessment/[id] = anonymous results page (app/(focused)/assessment/[id]/page.tsx); own error/loading boundaries.

ROUTE GROUP (app) — signed-in shell; layout gates via supabase.auth.getUser() and redirects to /auth?next=<safeNext(x-pathname)> when unauthenticated (app/(app)/layout.tsx:12-19); wraps children in data-corridor theme scope (MV-96, app/(app)/layout.tsx:23-26). Pages: /dashboard, /profile (13-section editor), /matches, /plan, /documents (vault), /checklist (landing that loads shortlist+programs, app/(app)/checklist/page.tsx), /checklist/[programId] (per-program checklist), /checklist/all (global program-agnostic document checklist, MV-53 comment at app/(app)/checklist/all/page.tsx:1), /guide (AI chat).
